grammar.title: 例外情况
lines: 3 Tramps seem to be the only exception to this general rule . seem to do 看似... exception to sth. 例外情况 Beggars almost sell themselves as human beings to arouse the pity of passers-by . Beggars sell their human dignity for the pity of passers-by. 替换 In seeking independence , they do not sacrifice their human dignity . in doing = in the process of doing 做某事的过程中... on / upon doing 刚一...马上就... seek v.寻找；寻求，谋求；请求 A tramp may ask you for money, but he will never ask you to feel sorry for him. feel sorry for ... 同情，怜悯：指对某人或某事感到难过、心疼或同情。 He has deliberately chosen to lead the life he leads and is fully aware of the consequences . lead the life he leads 过他过的那种生活 He may never be sure where the next meal is coming from , but he is free from the thousands of anxieties which afflict other people . be free from ... 免受，免于；没有…的，不受…影响的 free ... from ... 使...没有... afflict v.折磨，使痛苦 His few material possessions make it possible for him to move from place to place with ease. make it possible for sb. to do = enable sb. to do 使某人有可能做某事 from place to place 四处、四下里... A rolling stone gathers no moss. 滚石不生苔。；户枢不蠹，流水不腐。；转业不聚财。 By having to sleep in the open , he gets far closer to the world of nature than most of us ever do. in the open (air) outdoors 户外 than 引导比较状语从句的省略 He may hunt , beg , or steal occasionally to keep himself alive ; he may even , in times of real need, do a little work ; but he will never sacrifice his freedom. in times of happiness / grief / rage / crisis / boredom / war / peace ... 在幸福/悲伤/愤怒/危机/无聊/战争/和平之时…… We often speak of tramps with contempt and put them in the same class as beggars, but how many of us can honestly say that we have not felt a little envious of their simple way of life and their freedom from care ? 答在问中 We often speak contemptuously of tramps ... 使用副词替换 put ... in the same class as ... 把...归到同一类... rhetorical question 修辞疑问句（答在问中，往往出现在段落的末尾） 是指以疑问句形式出现，但却具有强烈的肯定或否定作用的一种句式。 修辞性疑问句不需要对方回答，因为所题出的问题或者是不言自明、无需要回答的，或者是问得对方无言以对、无法回答。 修辞性疑问也可以自问自答，以起到强调自己观点正确的作用。 每日习语 see eye to eye 见解一致, 看法相同
We s eem to have hit a problem. 我们似乎遇到了问题。
Tramps appear to be the only exception to this general rule. 写作替换
It seems that tramps are the only exception to this general rule. 写作替换
It appears that tramps are the only exception to this general rule. 写作替换
There are some exceptions to every grammatical rule. 每条语法规则都有例外。
The moment they reach out their hands they are beggars spiritually. 他们一伸出手，在精神上就是乞丐。
In trying to solve one problem, I created another.
On being observed , it immediately ran away .
Upon arriving at the university , I went straight to the dormitory.
seek refuge / asylum
seek compensation 寻求赔偿
seek comfort
seek reelection 寻求连任
Virgo woman seeks Scorpio man. 处女座女人追求天蝎座男人。
Even the bull seemed to feel sorry for him, for it looked on sympathetically until the drunk was out of the way before once more turning its attention to the matador .
have / feel sympathy for ... 对…表示同情 I feel sympathy for him for not passing his final. 我对他不能通过期终考感到同情。
sympathize with ... 同情，怜悯 I find it very hard to sympathize with him. 我觉得很难去同情他。
take pity on ... 对（某人或动物）表示怜悯并采取行动来帮助 Don't take pity on evil people! 不要怜惜恶人！
We only help those who really need help . 帮助真正需要帮助的人
God helps those who help themselves. 天道酬勤；皇天不负有心人
be aware of ... 意识到，知道：意识到某事或某物的存在或重要性 Advanced students need to be aware of the importance of collocation. 层次较高的学生必须意识到词语搭配的重要性。
be conscious of ... 意识到…；知道 He was conscious of a clock ticking. 他意识到了时间正在消逝。
be unconscious of ... 无意识的，未察觉到的：没有意识到或察觉到某事物或情况 She is unconscious of the effect she has on people. 她没有察觉自己对大众的影响。
be ignorant of ... 不知道，对……无知：缺乏知识或信息，不了解某事物或某情况 We might be ignorant of possibilities and alternatives. 我们或许没有意识到种种可能和选择。
be unaware of ... 不知道、未意识到、不知晓 They were unaware of the fate that was to befall them. 他们并不知道即将降临到他们头上的厄运。
He has been free from care since he retired .
The composition is free from errors.
Organic produce is free from harmful chemicals .
... but he frees himself from the thousands of anxieties ... 本句替换
He dedicated his life to freeing the world from famine and disease. 他一生致力于使世界摆脱饥荒和疾病。
which distress other people. 写作替换
which torture / rack / torment other people. 加强感觉
which other people suffer (from). 人做主语的替换
They devise hundreds of competitions which will enable us to win huge sums of money .
Radio and television have made it possible for advertisers to capture the attention of millions of people in this way .
here and there 四下、到处
hither and thither 古语
The Cutty Sark rolled from side to side and it became impossible to steer her .
from dawn to dusk 从早到晚
from head to foot 从头到脚
from top to bottom 从上到下
from start to finish 从头到尾
from cradle to grave 从生到死
Children need to play out in the open . 孩子需要在户外玩耍。
He is taller than I am . → He is taller than I / me .
occasionally 偶尔地 City born and city bred, I have always regarded the country as something you look at through a train window, or something you occasionally visit during the weekend .
once in a while 偶尔 There is no reason why you couldn't live it up once in a while . 没有理由不让你偶尔尽情玩乐一下的。
from time to time 时不时地：偶尔，不经常地 From time to time he passed on confidential information to him. 他不时地传送机密情报给他。
In times of peace , when business was bad, Hawkwood and his men would march into a city-state and, after burning down a few farms, would offer to go away if protection money was paid to them .
classify ... as ... 归类为：将某物或某人划分到某个类别或群体中。
... and classify them as beggars.
O, wind, if winter comes, can spring be far behind? 冬天了，春天还会远吗？ 'Ode to the West Wind' — P. B. Shelley
Who among us has not dreamed of that? 我们当中谁没有梦想过这一个呢?
What is the use of our studying grammar if we can't put the grammatical rules into practice? 如果我们不能把语法规则付诸实践，学习语法又有什么用呢?
Could any spectacle, for instance, be more grimly whimsical than that of gunners using science to shatter men's bodies while, close at hand, surgeons use it to restore them? NCE4-22
